senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חָטַט)to split, cut, chop.—Part. pass. חָטוּב.
units: <cite ref="Makkot 8a:13">Macc. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>אם מצא חָטוּב</he> (<he>אינו חוֹטֵב</he>) if he finds cut wood (for the religious purpose), he need not cut it.

senses.gloss: to eraze. Treat. Sofrim V, 1 מְחַטֵּב (Var. lect. מעטב, מעכב); (Treat. Sefer Torah, ed. Kirchh. V, 1 מַחֲטִּיב Hif.).
